subject: Piece of Heart
text: Activating the crystal switch in the icy floor with a bomb makes the ice blocks containing the Piece of Heart disappear so you can grab it.

evidence.quote: Now, before you leave the room, check the icy floor to find just the tip of a crystal switch hiding down there. Place a bomb right there to activate it. This will make the ice blocks containing the Piece of Heart above to disappear. Go grab it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song summons Pierre to an alcove, allowing Link to Hookshot up and kill a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Play your Scarecrow's Song and Pierre will appear up there. Hookshot up and kill the Gold Skulltula.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Shooting the crystal switch near the entrance alcove causes the ice block containing a Gold Skulltula under the red iced alcove to disappear.

evidence.quote: Now, go back to the alcove where you entered and look around for a crystal switch. Shoot it to make the ice block containing a Gold Skulltula under the red iced alcove disappear. Go there and kill the Skulltula.

subject: Iron Boots
text: Defeating the Stalfos in the concealed room allows Link to open a chest containing the Iron Boots.

evidence.quote: Kill or ignore the Ice Keese as you go through the tunnel, and enter the concealed door to find yourself in a really weird room, where you'll fight a Stalfos. Kill it, and open the chest to get the IRON BOOTS.

subject: Serenade of Water
text: Sheik teaches Link the Serenade of Water in the Ice Cavern.

evidence.quote: Sheik will teach you the SERENADE OF WATER as well.

subject: Dungeon Map
text: Hookshotting the targetable wall engraving causes a chest to appear that contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Hookshot the wall engraving that you can L-Target to make a chest appear. Open it for the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Compass
text: Defeating the two Lizalfos that appear near the wall engraving reveals a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Enter the door and kill the Spike by Hookshotting it, then slashing. Approach the wall engraving and two Lizalfos will appear. Kill them, then open the chest that appears for the COMPASS.

subject: Longshot
text: Hookshotting the wall engraving in the small elevated room makes a treasure chest appear containing the Longshot.

evidence.quote: Hookshot the wall engraving to make a treasure chest appear. Open it for the LONGSHOT.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Lighting the torch with Din's Fire opens the gate and kills the Gold Skulltula behind it so you can collect the token.

evidence.quote: At the end, you'll find another gate which can only be opened by lighting the torch. Use Din's Fire to light the torch and kill the Gold Skulltula there, so just collect the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Longshotting through the ceiling hole and breaking the crates reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Longshot up through the hole in the ceiling, and break the crates up here to find a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Small Key
text: Longshotting the wall engraving makes a small chest fall down containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: This will reveal a crystal switch. Hit it to open up another grating in the ceiling. Go there and Longshot up. Longshot the wall engraving to make a small chest fall down. Open it for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located near the ceiling by the second whirlpool of the underground river.

evidence.quote: Look up near the ceiling to find a Gold Skulltula. Longshot it and its token.

subject: Boss Key
text: Lighting all torches with Din's Fire from atop the geyser opens the gate to a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: At its top, use Din's Fire to light all the torches to open the gate. Quickly jump over and open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Breaking the crates in the room beyond the Dodongo hallway reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: In here, break the crates to find a Gold Skulltula. Kill it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Lighting the torches with Fire Arrows and summoning Pierre allows Link to access a room with a Gold Skulltula on the ceiling.

evidence.quote: Shoot the torches with Fire Arrows to light them (you're too far away to use Din's Fire, I believe). Now, play your Scarecrow's Song to summon Pierre, and Longshot to him. Kill the Stalfos, then enter the small room that used to be blocked by a gate. Look up to see the Gold Skulltula.

subject: Dungeon Map
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby at the Triforce symbol opens a gate leading to a chest with the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: See the Triforce symbol? Play Zelda's Lullaby there to open the nearby gate. Go through that and open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Compass
text: Defeating Dead Hand after draining the water yields a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Head back to where you entered and jump into the now-empty hole in the ground. Go through the crawlspace, climb up, and enter the door to fight the Dead Hand. Once it's killed, open the chest for the COMPASS.

subject: Small Key
text: Bombing the cracked dirt mound reveals a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Now, find the mound of dirt around here that has...a crack in it, and bomb it. Pick up the SMALL KEY and head back to the main room.

subject: Lens of Truth
text: In the southeastern corridor past the ReDeads, opening the chest yields the Lens of Truth.

evidence.quote: Step into the central area down here, and take the southeastern corridor (the one with all the blue fires) to find some ReDeads. Stun them with the Sun's Song and grab the LENS OF TRUTH from the chest, to avoid fighting those deadly things.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found at the end of the northwestern corridor guarded by Big Skulltulas.

evidence.quote: Take the northwestern corridor while having the Lens of Truth on to fight some Big Skulltulas. Take them down as you progress and get the Gold Skulltula at the end.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the left room of the central jail chamber, defeating the invisible enemies and pulling back the gravestone reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Enter the left door in here and use the Lens of Truth to take out all the invisible enemies. Once they're gone, pull the gravestone back to reveal a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Small Key
text: Following the invisible path in the right room of the central jail leads to an alcove with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Put on the Lens of Truth to see an invisible path. Take it to the alcove and pick up the SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is hidden behind the statue to the right in the locked room past the grating.

evidence.quote: Head to the back of this room and look behind the statue to the right to find a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Bird Statue
text: Twisting the bird statue so its beak faces the skull that does not disappear when viewed with the Lens of Truth opens the gate ahead.

evidence.quote: To begin with, see the bird statue and the skull pillars surrounding it? Use the Lens of Truth to find the skull that doesn't disappear when seen, and twist the statue around so its beak faces that skull. This will open the gate ahead.

subject: Small Key
text: Defeating the Gibdos behind the fake skull barricade makes a chest appear with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: In here, kill the Gibdos to make a chest appear. Open it for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Dungeon Map
text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees and defeating the Big Skulltula opens the cage and unseals the exit, revealing a chest with the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Your objective is to collect all five Silver Rupees here. It should be obvious on how to get these. Enter the cage that opens and kill the Big Skulltula there. By now, if you've killed them all, the door back out should've opened up. Open the chest for the DUNGEON MAP.

subject: Compass
text: Defeating the four ReDeads reveals a chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Use the Sun's Song to stun them first to be safe, then kill them one by one. The door back out will open, and a chest will appear. Open it for the COMPASS.

subject: Hover Boots
text: Defeating the Dead Hand unlocks a chest containing the Hover Boots.

evidence.quote: Go through the door and fight the Dead Hand. After it's dead, open the chest for the HOVER BOOTS.
